title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
lineage: MAC > CDR from Jim Wise. CDR > EAC > WavMerge > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC
source: Beyers M160's > Sony TC-D5, near the Sbd > MAC

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience‑sourced recording of a high‑energy 1982 show featuring scorching Bertha, Mexicali Blues, Playin’ in the Band and an inspired Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this concert’s fiery performance – from Jerry’s hot picking on Bertha and Mexicali Blues to the soaring Playin’ in the Band → Eyes of the World sequence. The audience recording is praised as crystal‑clear, though one notes Phil’s bass sits a bit low in the mix. Overall it’s a top‑notch show captured with excellent sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly positive about the musical performance and describe an excellent audience source, but only two detailed reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced capture praised as outstanding; minor mix issue noted with Phil’s bass being low in the overall blend.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with Bertha, seamless transitions through Mexicali Blues into Althea > Little Light > Big River Blues > Let It Grow, a lush Cold Rain & Snow, then a powerful Playin' in the Band → Eyes of the World space and concluding Earthquake Space > Reprise.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Warmed up on Bertha, delivers hot picking, super‑fast strumming, leads jams and locks with Brent during Eyes of the World.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass playing is spot‑on but buried too low in the mix throughout the tour.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mickey (referred to as Bobby) provides solid cymbal work; good interplay with the rest of the band.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland adds church‑organ texture on Cold Rain & Snow and meshes tightly with Jerry’s guitar during the space sections.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann noted for a mean cymbal ride; drummers ready to launch into high‑energy peaks.
